## Description

Owner screens: plan and seats, invoices from Medvya, update payment method, add seats, close the practice (full export first). Console: INR and AED reported separately, never summed. Dunning: retries day 3 and 7, reminder day 14, limited mode day 30 (online bookings pause), read-only day 60, suspended day 90; patients and clinical records are never locked for non-payment. Only the owner sees plan and billing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a payment fails, when day 30 is reached, then online bookings pause and clinicians can still read and treat.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a non-owner, when opens billing, then the API returns 403.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a practice is closed, when the owner confirms, then a full export is offered first and the plan stops at the end of the paid period.

## Notes / open questions

- Scope (ADR-016 (docs/adr/ADR-016-organisation-onboarding-and-approval.md)): the subscription belongs to the organisation, not to a doctor or a location. Seats (doctors, staff, patients) are counted per organisation in total across its locations; the starter plan of MDV-P1-069 (1 doctor and 2 other staff) is what applies until a plan is bought. The owner upgrades and adds seats self-service and is responsible for the choice. Invoices carry the organisation's own tax number (GSTIN or TRN), not a location's. An organisation that is not Approved (set-up-only mode, Needs changes or Rejected) has no paid subscription: billing creates no trial, invoice or dunning for it, and the subscription starts only when the organisation is Approved. A Suspended organisation keeps its subscription record, dunning is paused while the suspension lasts, and existing records stay readable for care. "Close practice" means closing the organisation (MDV-P5-049).
